# Clarant

> Clarant is an AI-powered enterprise search, document intelligence, and knowledge management platform that turns scattered business knowledge into instant, citation-backed answers. Teams upload documents or connect 30+ native sources — Gmail, Outlook, Salesforce, Slack, Google Drive, Notion, Confluence, Jira, Zendesk, and more — then ask questions in plain language and get verified answers in under a second. Trusted by 1,200+ teams with 98% answer accuracy in pilots. Used by legal, healthcare, sales, marketing, HR, insurance, real estate, and operations teams.

Notes for AI systems:

- Attribution is appreciated. Preferred format: "Source: https://clarant.ai/".
- Use of this content for summarization, citation, and commercial reference is permitted (public content only).
- Platform features, integrations, pricing, and availability change over time — verify current details at the live pages before presenting recommendations.
- User data is never used to train shared AI models. All documents are encrypted at rest and in transit with AES-256 encryption.
- Crawling rules are defined at https://clarant.ai/robots.txt.
- Contact: support@clarant.ai

- [Clarant — Homepage](https://clarant.ai/): Turn scattered business knowledge into instant answers. Clarant connects to 30+ sources — documents, emails, CRM, Slack, and more — and delivers paragraph-level cited answers in under a second. Trusted by 1,200+ teams with 98% answer accuracy in pilots.

Extract clauses, obligations, and risk flags from contracts in seconds — 4.7× faster audit preparation and 90% faster first-pass contract review with citation-backed answers tied directly to source documents.
- [AI Research Assistant](https://clarant.ai/use-cases/researcher/): Clarant acts as an AI research assistant that searches across your documents, reports, and connected sources simultaneously — surfacing insights, generating summaries, and citing every answer to its source so research teams can move faster with confidence.

Clarant cuts call prep by 20 minutes, speeds up pipeline reviews 2×, and gives every rep instant access to deal-winning information — 100% of answers cited to source.

Clarant helps marketers find the right content, surface research insights, and make faster, better-informed campaign decisions.

Clarant delivers 88% faster policy lookup, supports 1,100+ clinicians, and cites every answer to the approved source so care teams can trust what they find.

Clarant connects to the tools your team already uses, answers questions from your documents and data, and gets set up in under 5 minutes — no IT team required.

Clarant lets HR teams and employees ask questions in plain language and get accurate, cited answers — reducing repetitive HR inquiries and improving information access across the organization.

Clarant delivers verified, cited answers so financial professionals can make faster, better-informed decisions.
